name: Mirelle Thornbloom
title: Herbalist
description: A warm, bustling elf with soil under her nails and a sprig of rosemary tucked behind one ear. She will sell you an antidote, but not before asking exactly what bit you.

greeting.first_time: Oh! Come in, come in, mind the drying racks. I'm Mirelle. Are you hurt, poisoned, or just curious? It's usually one of the three.
greeting.returning: Back again, dear? Let me look at you. Hm. You'll live.
greeting.low_gold: I've no coin left to buy with today, I'm afraid. Bring it round tomorrow.

sleeping.text: *A cat on the windowsill watches you. Inside, all is quiet.*

traveling_to_work.text: I open at eight, once the morning herbs are cut. Come by then!

traveling_home.text: That's the day done. If it's an emergency, chew willow bark and come at eight.

off_duty.text: The Mortar's closed for the night, dear. Eight o'clock.

main_menu.text: Now, what can the Green Mortar do for you?

browse_shop.text: Everything's labelled. The spores are the ones that glow; don't sniff them.

ask_about_herbs.text: Pollen, sap and bark for the druids, silk and spores for the rangers' snares and charms. Potions take me days to brew, so I keep only a couple on the shelf. Totems and yew wands? Those are made by the old circles for their own. You won't find one for sale.

goodbye.text: Eat something green, and come back in one piece!
